company.name: BERTEL O STEEN AS
company.summary: BERTEL O STEEN AS is a private limited company (aksjeselskap) registered under engroshandel med motorvogner (NACE 46.710), based in Lørenskog, founded 1956-10-01. Registered activity: Handel, industri, eie og bestyre fast eiendom, agenturvirksomhet, utleie av kjøretøy og alt hva som dermed står i forbindelse, derunder også deltagelse i annen virksomhet. Latest filed accounts (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31, company accounts): revenue NOK 9.1 bn, operating result NOK -50.2 m, net result NOK 49.6 m, total assets NOK 5.0 bn, equity NOK 1.6 bn. The period closed with a profit. Change from 2024 to 2025: revenue went from NOK 8.6 bn to NOK 9.1 bn (+6%); net result went from NOK -75.7 m to NOK 49.6 m; equity went from NOK 1.7 bn to NOK 1.6 bn (-7%). Financial position in 2025: operating margin -0.6%; equity ratio 32.0%. Calculated from the filed figures above. Registered employees: 473. Leadership in the official register: Harald Frigstad (managing director); Helge Leiro Baastad (chair of the board); Anna Elisabeth Nord Bjercke (board member); Line Margrethe Aarnes (board member); plus 12 further roles. 3 registered workplaces in Lørenskog, Skedsmokorset, Trondheim. Most recent registry event: Registered employee count updated (2026-11-12). Not established from checked sources: verified website (ambiguous); website description (ambiguous); company-owned social profiles (ambiguous); active job ads (not available). Missing information is not treated as zero.
